name: Floating Garden of Bioluminescent Orchids
description: A garden suspended in mid‑air, roots entwined with glowing vines, orchids pulsing in rhythm with a hidden heartbeat.
prompt: A levitating garden platform surrounded by mist. Bioluminescent orchids in electric blues, pinks, and greens bloom from vines that coil around floating stones. Subtle pulse animation suggested by light intensity. Dreamy, high‑resolution, 8K.
caption: Gardens that float and glow to the rhythm of the earth. 🌺✨ #FloatingBioluminescentOrchids
